verdict.rationale: USPTO documents that users make direct API calls against Patent Center's Workbench/view-applications surfaces. Probes confirm a real authenticated machine endpoint (api.uspto.gov answers with a structured auth challenge) and a developer portal, so some system-to-system channel exists. However, the documented API usage covers viewing applications, not transacting (filing or paying). No system-account, transmitter, or batch-provider program or enrollment path appears in the readable evidence, and the developer portal docs are not readable without JS. Missing for 10: documented machine filing/payment channel, published enrollment path for system accounts or transmitter/batch programs, readable API documentation, independent corroboration.
